shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright stone slab/monolith
human or anthropomorphic figures shown frontally/in profile on a vertical face
incised symbolic signs arranged in rows
justification: Both are upright slabs carved in low relief with schematic anthropomorphic imagery, a prominent disc motif, and horizontal dividing lines creating registers, but that is about as generic as such correspondences get. A shows a single massive body-like form with a pectoral disc, arms and a headdress of vertical incised strips, whereas B shows two small standing figures facing a central column of signs beneath an arched sky-band, with raised arms and staffs — different compositions, proportions and relationships entirely.
